This chapter describes how snapy fills the ghost cells of a block, which face fluxes it prescribes, and how it
treats immersed solids, at the code pin `73c45a7c`. It follows the outline's three parts: the boundary kinds
(@sec-ch14-registry to @sec-ch14-wb), the prescribed faces (@sec-ch14-prescribed) and the immersed solids
(@sec-ch14-solids). Three mechanisms fill ghosts and are kept apart throughout: the physical face callbacks that a block installs
from its YAML[^rg-aa1d9fab98ea] card (reflecting, periodic, extrapolation, outflow, custom, solid), the layout exchange that
fills the ghosts a neighbouring block owns, and the solid mask that closes fluid faces inside the block. The
chapter derives, for each callback, the discrete identity it implements (parity, permutation, constant
extension, characteristic selection and admissibility), the ownership rule that decides which of the two
fillers writes a ghost and when, the line optimum of the mask rectification, the reflecting closure of the
implicit system against a solid, and the wall continuation of the hydrostatic reference. Every claim is read from
the code at the pin; no solver run is reported here, and the
solver tests the schemes cite are catalogued, with their assertions, in @sec-ch16-ch11.

@fig-ch14-opening-dependencies shows which scheme needs which. The complete switch matrix is
@sec-ch12-matrix; the stage ownership map is @sec-ch01-stage.

#| echo: false

| @sec-ch14-reflecting | `reflecting` | on (the default face name) | exact parity; wall order unmeasured | @sec-ch16-ch11 |
| @sec-ch14-periodic | `periodic` | off | exact permutation; seam order unmeasured | @sec-ch16-ch11 |
| @sec-ch14-extrapolation | `extrapolation` | off; the fallback of `outflow` for scalars and shallow water | $O(h)$ ghost consistency; solver order unmeasured | @sec-ch16-ch11 |

| @sec-ch14-exchange | `SyncOptions` | `interpolate` off, `skip_corner` on | exact copy on matched cells; a corner copied from its diagonal neighbour, else averaged | @sec-ch16-ch11 |
